General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Recline Mechanism that connects the outside portion of the Seat Back and the Seat Cushion together on the Passenger Side Seat.
Allows for tilting of the Seat Back in both a forward and reverse direction.
NOTE: The Geo Tracker was made by Suzuki Motor Corporation. Parts made by Suzuki are OEM parts for the Geo Tracker.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Seat Recline Mechanism – RH Side (Passengers Side)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Geo Tracker 1989 – 1998 All Models
Suzuki Samurai 1985- 1995 All Models
